title: Distribution of Sandpile groups of random directed bipartite graphs
summary: Fix a prime $p$ and a constant $\frac{1}{p}<α\leq 1$. Consider the random directed Erdős--Rényi bipartite graph $\vec G(n,\lceilαn\rceil ,v)$ with bipartition $(V_1,V_2)$ of sizes $|V_1|=n$ and $|V_2|=\lceilαn\rceil$, and edge probability $0<v<1$. Bhargava, DePascale and Koenig conjectured a limiting distribution for the $p$-Sylow subgroup of the sandpile group of $\vec G(n,\lceilαn\rceil,v)$ as $n\to\infty$. We prove this conjecture.
